subject: Re: Kickoff: ACT clarification-turn service — alpha decision
body:
Team,

Decision for the May 15 gate: we ship the alpha with the full-size ACT model and mark the distilled student as beta. Maren's regenerated contrastive pairs recovered most of the gap (now -1.8pp on clarification-action accuracy vs teacher), but I don't want a partner team's first impression to carry a known regression.

So:
- Alpha on May 15 with the teacher model, partner team confirmed.
- Distillation recipe keeps its staffing into next quarter — it's still the path to a hostable service, and I'll carry it as a named deliverable in the Q3 planning doc.
- Vera, please make sure the Evalline suite includes the ambiguous-turn slice so we can track the student catching up.

Good quarter, folks — this went from repo to partner-facing in eleven weeks.

Dmitri
